name: Fungal-infected litter
description: Dead leaves of the fog-broom grass heavily colonised by fungi - the high-quality litter that decomposers selectively pick: the mixing model credits it with about 70% of the oribatid mite's diet and 67% of the ladybird's (the same selectivity shown by Namib termites). Functional group matching the source's 'dead leaves with fungal infection' basal pool.
